claim.claim-text: 1. A method for the production of a graphene layer structure, the method comprising:

providing a substrate on a heated susceptor in a reaction chamber, the chamber having a plurality of cooled inlets arranged so that, in use, the inlets are distributed across the substrate and have a constant separation from the substrate, rotating the heated susceptor at a rotation rate of at least 300 rpm, supplying a flow comprising a precursor compound through the inlets and into the reaction chamber to thereby decompose the precursor compound and form graphene on the substrate, wherein the inlets are cooled to less than 100°C, preferably 50 to 60°C, and the susceptor is heated to a temperature of at least 50°C in excess of a decomposition temperature of the precursor, wherein the substrate provides a crystalline surface upon which the graphene is produced, and wherein the constant separation is at least 12 cm and preferably from 12 to 20 cm.
2. The method according to claim 1, wherein the precursor compound comprises an organic compound optionally comprising at least one heteroatom.
3. The method according to claim 2, wherein the precursor compound comprises an organic compound, wherein the organic compound does not comprise a heteroatom.
4. The method according to claim 2 or claim 3, wherein the organic compound has at least one covalent C-C bond.
5. The method according to any preceding claim, wherein the precursor compound comprises H<2>O as a contaminant.
6. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the rotation rate is from 600 to 3000 rpm, preferably from 1000 to 1500 rpm.
7. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the constant separation is about 15 cm.

8. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the substrate comprises sapphire, silicon carbide, silicon, diamond, a nitride semiconductor material, or an arsenide/phosphide semiconductor.
9. The method according to claim 8, wherein the substrate comprises sapphire or silicon carbide, preferably sapphire.
10. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the substrate has a diameter of at least 5 cm (2 inches), preferably 15 to 30 cm (6 to 12 inches).
11. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the substrate has a thickness of 50 to 300 microns, preferably 100 to 200 microns, preferably about 150 microns.
12. The method according to any of the preceding claims, wherein the graphene layer structure is undoped.
13. The method according to claim 12, wherein the flow further comprises a dilution gas, wherein the dilution gas comprises nitrogen.
